Appreciate the context and the HubSpot link. Can you attach the usage export (CSV) and list the five highest-traffic prompts and approximate token volumes? I’ll kick this to our eval-credit committee for a quick review.

I pulled the usage export (attached: usage-report-20271018.csv). Quick findings from the automated signal:
- Account: atlasai.com mapped to 3 distinct HubSpot contacts over the last 72 days.
- Top IP clusters: 54.223.112.0/24 and 18.205.33.0/24; one IP range maps to a cloud testbed used by multiple teams internally.
- Token pattern: three short bursts (15–30k tokens) followed by a steady trickle. No obvious prompt injections, but entropy on prompt patterns is high (similar prompts repeated with minor substitutions).

Recommendation: elevate to policy committee given repeat grants and multi-contact footprint. This preserves commercial path while reducing abuse risk.
